headline: NYM @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYM 5.51 at WSN 5.15, with a projected total of 10.66. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: NYM moved +0.91 runs while WSN moved +1.17, changing the projected margin by -0.26 runs. The projected total climbed +2.08, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Cade Cavalli has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Carson Benge, Juan Soto, Daylen Lile, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags MJ Melendez, Nasim Nuñez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
